symptom: Building a headless agent on the pi SDK: `import { Type } from "@sinclair/typebox"` failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, and there is no @sinclair dir in ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules.
cause: pi ships TypeBox under the bare package name `typebox` (v1.3.27, ESM-only, build/index.mjs) inside the release's own node_modules, not as @sinclair/typebox. pi-coding-agent lives in ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/<ver>/node_modules/, not in ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules.
fix: In an out-of-tree project, symlink both into ./node_modules: `ln -s ~/.pi/agent/install/releases/<ver>/node_modules/@earendil-works node_modules/@earendil-works` and `ln -s .../node_modules/typebox node_modules/typebox`. Then `import { Type } from "typebox"` and `import { createAgentSession, ModelRuntime, DefaultResourceLoader, SessionManager, SettingsManager } from "@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent"`. Custom tools are registered through a DefaultResourceLoader `extensionFactories: [(pi) => pi.registerTool({name,label,description,parameters,execute})]` and `noTools: true` so only they are active. Model: `const rt = await ModelRuntime.create(); rt.getModel("opencode-go","deepseek-v4.1-flash")`.
verify: node -e "import('typebox').then(m=>console.log(typeof m.Type))" and a smoke session whose session.getActiveToolNames() lists only the custom tools.
